newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen shares flutter lower on minor correction.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen shares flutter lower on minor correction.

text.p: Shenzhen's A and B share indices closed slightly lower on Tuesday on a consolidation, but traders expected bullish sentiment to lift prices later this week before the Chinese lunar new year holiday.
The B share index shaved off 0.10 points or 0.06 percent to close at 153.17 on turnover of HK$152.41 million compared with HK$165.37 million on Monday.
The A share index lost 0.67 points or 0.18 percent to 370.14, with turnover shrinking to 6.20 billion yuan from Monday's 7.37 billion.

"Today's retreat can been seen as a normal fluctuation," a trader said. Investor confidence in the economy, boosted recently by economic forecasts that included a prediction of 6.0 percent retail price inflation this year, could fuel a rebound this week, before the lunar new year holiday, traders said.
"Institutions are expected to stay away from large-scale trading before the two-week lunar new year holiday," one trader said. The two-week markets holiday starts on February 3.
On the B share market, Dadonghai Tourism performed worst, sinking HK$0.15 or 3.61 percent on profit-taking to HK$4.00 on volume of 3.86 million shares, brokers said.
Changan Automobile was the second biggest loser and slumped HK$0.15 to HK$4.65 on trade of 2.00 million shares.
The biggest gainer was Hainan Pearl River, which soared HK$0.25 or 7.25 percent to HK$3.70, with 3.74 million shares changing hands.

Pearl River's surge was fuelled by expectations of strong 1996 results on the sale of a Shanghai property project, brokers said. A company spokesman said last year's performance would be similar to 1995 when the company earned 0.0137 yuan per share.
On the A share market, department store-owner Tongcheng fell 0.43 yuan or 3.02 percent to 13.79 yuan on turnover 1.64 million shares.
Dadonghai, which listed 11 million A shares and three million staff shares in Shenzhen on Tuesday, ended its debut at 12.55 yuan on volume of 10.77 million shares.
The A shares were issued at 3.20 yuan each recently, while staff shares were issued at face value of one yuan each in 1993.
